identifier: texas pride heating and air:keller, tx

reviews.text:
We love Texas Pride. Each technician really takes pride in their work and the company. They always take time to explain and educate! Today we had Brantley and hope to have him again. He'd make an excellent teacher. :)
We also love Chelsey in scheduling. She is very courteous and caring. I hesitate to add names because really we are happy with them all. We are part of the Premier Program and have enjoyed the savings it has provide.  I recommend Texas Pride!

The technician, Gabriel and his assistant, did a great job. Thorough, and still timely. He was very knowledgeable and courteous. I recommend Texas Pride, especially if you’re local. Have had great service and experience with them. No hassle and “surprise” charges. Prices are reasonable and affordable. Very satisfied customer.

Never thought I would be excited about the HVAC guys coming, but Jacob is absolutely wonderful. Even my dogs get so excited every time he comes. We have been part of the bluebonnet membership for a couple of years now and the regular maintenance at the change of season alone makes the membership completely worth it. It also makes repairs affordable when they do come up. Truly could not be happier with this service. They are by far my favorite company I have hired to work on my home.

This company truely cares about their customers. All the techs are professionals and freindly. They go the extra mile to take care of your ac/heating issues. And have really come thru for me. I am grateful for the excellent service and will be a loyal Texas Pride customer.

Honestly this is the best company, we got our ac from them being pregnant and in Texas summer heat they were able to get here on VERY short notice and did an amazing job, then last night we noticed a leak in our ceiling at 9pm and they were able to show up in 30 min! Best service and they are so helpful I’ll recommend anyone to them they are the best. You pay for quality it’s honestly amazing

As members of their affordable Blue Bonnet club we have never had trouble getting someone out same day or early next day. Affordable, reliable, and the guys that have come out have always been very willing to discuss and explain the issue to make sure I know what’s going on. They have also always. Even willing to discuss options on temporary fixed or more permanent solutions without feeling like they are selling things to me.

Knowledgeable and efficient service. Would recommend these guys! Update on 4/1/2024 - My AC compressor wouldn't turn on. I called them and they had someone here in 15 minutes and the problem was fixed in 30 minutes. I stand by my earlier review.
Update on 9/23/24. I had another great service call from the guys at Texas Pride. Serviced my mini-split in my garage. Great and friendly service!

I can’t say enough great things about Texas Pride Heating and Air! From start to finish, the entire experience was smooth, professional, and stress-free. Received a tuneup on our AC  for the start of summer, and discovered some issues (bent furnace door) that were causing the unit not to work as efficiently.

The technicians, Duncan & Gabriel were friendly, knowledgeable, and explained everything clearly. Diagnosed the issue quickly, fixed the bent door, cleaned the coils, and had us ready to go
Jacob was great to work with! He was personable, communicated clearly, and answered all of my questions. He quickly diagnosed the problem with my a/c and got it fixed within a few hours.

Fantastic service and experience! Quick and easy to get an appointment and costs were appropriate. It was a difficult install but the techs were outstanding and worked diligently to get it perfect. They even put up with my messy house and garage.

The Dispatcher, April, is always super friendly, and called to update me with any minor delays and see if it was still a good time for them to come by. I love that you can track their vehicle to know precisely where they are and how long of a wait, almost like an uber.

Chaz the tech was able to come out late at night, and quickly able to figure out what the issue was.

And the other tech Duncan was also very nice!
So far we have loved our service with Texas Pride and enjoyed everyone we’ve inte

WOW! Texas Pride installed a mini-split AC/Heating unit in a secondary dwelling / Tiny House on our property. The unit works great, and is energy efficient for our climate. We sincerely adored their staff, and the respect they showed for our military family was abounding. We have lived in many states throughout our military career, and we've owned several homes that entailed multiple Heating and Air maintenance relationships over the years and these guys are hands down the best! Quality service,

The service i got from Texas Pride Heating and Air was simply great! I will never waste time and money with big companies like Tom's or Ben Franklin again! Five stars and immense respect for Chaz, who did my repair!
Very prompt and polite service tech.  When I call in I’m always well treated.  Customer service is clearly important to Texas Pride Heating  and Air

Chaz was straight forward, honest, no B.S. and didn't try to up-sell me any parts or repairs. Just took care of business and fixed my ac unit at a very reasonable price. Plus, being a very nice guy and I was pleased to make his acquaintance. I told him he was my new hvac guy. No need to go anywhere else.

Texas Pride Heating and Air was phenomenal to work with. I had an appointment scheduled with ease. I had to adjust my appointment and that was with ease. The technicians were nice and friendly and made sure to answer all my questions as well as educate me about what I was experiencing. Top notch all around!

We had a bad experience with another company and they turned us over to Texas Pride finally admitting after putting in a new a/c and many thousands later they could not fix the problem. Texas Pride sent Jacob today with a buddy and in ten mins he found one problem and fixed it and in twenty mins more figured out the rest. After almost two years and many thousands later we believe we now have answers to our problems. Thats what you get when Qualified, Quality people are hired.Jacob was not only s

Every time we have had them out we have been super happy. First time a couple of years ago we called them on a day when it was 100 degrees out and the ac had stopped. They came out same day and had it working again. This last time we called them out for ac leaking. They came out the day we set the appointment for and had it fixed. No more leaking.

Wow, can't express how grateful we are for Texas Pride Heating and Air.  From the time we called to the time we paid we were 100% satisfied.  They really do go above and beyond, they keep you informed as to what is happening.  Can't thank them enough for installing the last piece of our home and taking that Texas pride in making it beautiful.  Definitely will be a repeat customer.

I would like to start off by thanking Chaz for bringing a window unit to use for free! until the install was complete. he installed the window unit and we had it for a day or so, this was a few years ago. never had a chance to write a review until the yearly reminder for maintenance or check up etc  was messaged. system is working good and they're always checking to see if everything is ok. I give Texas pride 5 stars. ✭ ✭ ✭ ✭ ✭
As always, punctual, friendly and complete in their service. Lot of great folks work their and many have been there for years. Always a good sign!
Texas Pride got to me sooner than I expected and had my AC up and running in a short time. I'd recommend them to anyone.

Texas Pride Heating & Air Tech Simeon came out and assessed the situation that we were having in a quick and prompt manner. They explained it in words that made sense, answered all questions and did the work in a very professional manner. We gladly recommend them to all our friends and family.

Called for a tech when our AC went out & received a call back immediately! When our technician, Jacob arrived, he went to work immediately & repaired it quickly. This man was kind & friendly & I would not hesitate to recommend him as a referral to everyone I know. Thank you Jacob for being amazing!

Texas Pride Heating and Air are amazing! The service was great. They were able to work me in quick. Jacob was extremely knowledgeable and had my unit working again in no time. April in the office was so helpful and kind. I would definitely recommend them.

Simon was an amazing tech. He came in, got the job done in a very clean manner, was polite and gave me great service. Some would say the greatest service ever. Thank you for making air conditioning great again.

We were referred to Texas Pride.  Texas Pride responded on short notice, completed the replacement job quickly and professionally. Our new AC was up in running in one day. Worth every penny.  Their employees were knowledgeable. professional and helpful.  We highly recommend them.
Brantley does great work. Makes recommendations that may help save money. Will keep using Texas Pride to service our A/C system. Another good visit from TX Pride.

Texas Pride installed a new AC system at our house and I am very happy with the experience and results. Our old system was undersized and couldn’t keep the house cool on hot days. Chaz helped me understand why we needed an upgrade and he was right. He and his team were courteous, friendly, and went out of their way to proactively explain everything to me while they were here. Highly recommend!

Each time I've needed assistance with my HVAC Texas Pride Heating and Air has come to the rescue. Not only did they look for an earlier service call opening they also introduced me to a maintenance program to ensure proper tune-up. Kudos to April and Jacob!
Jacob supersedes the words great, amazing, awesome.   We trust him completely!!!!

Great value! Customer focused and quick to respond!
Competitive pricing and quality work they stand behind!!
Jacob did a great job replacing our A/C thermostat.  Thank you!

We bought an entire new HVAC system for our house. This group was competitive with prices, competent, helpful, incredibly friendly, and answered all questions and concerns. Worked so hard to make sure everything was just right. The owner was amazing and even stopped by to check on everything. We couldn’t be more pleased with the service provided and the professionalism of the entire team.
You can Trust these folks, and that counts more than any other compliment or accolades that I could bestow upon a company.  Especially a service company.  Thank you Texas Pride.

I had my new system installed by Texas Pride Heating and Air and I cannot be happier. They came to give me a quote and they installed the new unit the next day. We won’t struggle with the heat this summer. All staff is very friendly and professional. It was great pricing as well. Highly recommend this company!

Update 5/31/23: we had an anomaly happen this afternoon with our unit today that caused it to stop working and house quickly heated up.   Texas Pride sent the team out same day on short notice in the evening.  Brantley quickly diagnosed and fixed the problem.  We are actually happier with his fix because we did not like the fresh-air flow vent the builder installed.  We are Texas Pride customers for life and will recommend them to others!

I found Texas Pride recommended by neighbors on NextDoor

Brantley did an excellent job of providing knowledgeable customer service with detailed explanation of assessment and services. He kindly talked me through his evaluation and expertly guided me on the series of next steps. He was courteous and respectful and never seemed to rush through anything. I especially appreciated the feature where the dispatch sent the name and picture ID of who I should be expecting as well as a tracking map to see how close he was to arriving at my home. We will certai
Was here on time very polite and upfront. I found my new heater and air conditioning tech.

Unlike other companies I called, Texas Pride answered right away and tried their best to get out to my house ASAP.

My technician, Jacob, was awesome. He fixed the problem quickly and I’m happy with the service and cost.

Brantley was very thorough in reviewing my system and diagnosing the issues with my AC System.  He was very knowledgeable and took his time to explain everything that was going on and did not rush through anything even though it was later in the evening. Same day service with a late in the day call from Texas Pride was unexpected and very much appreciated. Would definitely recommend.

Amazing service! My A/C went out and needed to be replaced. Chaz and his team were at my home first thing in the morning. After reviewing what was needed, they were on the job next day to do a full a/c & furnace replacement. Texas pride is a small family operated company. It was a pleasure working with them.

Texas Pride is very professional and I have used their services for our numerous rental properties. This call was for a rental property on a weekend and they were responsive and got it back operational within hours. They communicated on the way to the appointment and after appointment to let me know how it was repaired. Their prices are also very reasonable.

We got quotes from 5 different companies and I am glad this is the last one we got it from. We chose them as they told us what the issue was. Chaz and Angel were so nice and very knowledgeable during the whole process from estimate quote to replacing unit. Harry came out with them and was also very nice no up selling it was like a family member was doing the service honestly. Unfortunately diagnosis was replacement of unit but they had all bases covered detailing what had to be done to the finan

April who answered the phone was super nice and very helpful. Got me scheduled for early the next morning.
Jacob and Tyler were super. Arrived on time, very kind, worked their buts off to get my unit fixed.
They are definitely my go to guys from now on.

When my A/C stopped cooling I had reached out to a few different companies. This was a Sunday and no one was able to come out until Tuesday. I made the call to Texas Pride Heating and Air and they were able to get a technician out within probably half an hour. Brantley was great to work with and was able to diagnose within about 5 minutes of being there. He had parts on hand to fix my issue and I was back up and running in no time. I am extremely impressed with the service I received and have si

Affordable, quick, professional and great quality work! I really can't express how thankful I am that we found Texas Pride. I live out of state and my elderly parents AC went out. Even though I couldn't be there to help them, Texas Pride took care of them!
Jacob and Toby were prompt efficient and followed the coupon discount to the letter. Excellent service and highly recommended!

We bought our AC unit from Texas Pride a few years ago, and haven’t had nothing but optimal customer service, and care since purchasing it. I’ve been amazed at how much each individual cares about their job and ensures that you understand everything they’re saying. They seem to truly care about each of their clients, we feel valued and understood every time they come out. I wish every company we worked with used them as a business model.

Jacob is outstanding!
Fantastic job! I would HIGHLY recommend!
